# luno — Full API Reference for AI Agents

> Extended Public + Agent API reference. **Start with the curated index:** https://doc.luno.rest/llms.txt  
> Product overview & pricing: https://luno.rest/llms.txt

luno is a headless CMS on Cloudflare Workers + PostgreSQL (Hyperdrive). Public API base: `https://{your-domain}/public/v1` (no auth). Agent API: `https://api.luno.rest/admin/v1` with `Authorization: Bearer sk-agent-…`.

---

## Content Model

```
Form Set  (content type, identified by slug, e.g. "blog")
  └── Entry  (individual content item, identified by slug)
        └── Revision  (versioned content; only "published" revisions returned)
              └── Snapshot  (field values at this revision)
```

Only entries with a `published` revision appear in the Public API responses.

---

## All Endpoints

### GET /form-sets/{slug}

Returns form set metadata and the published content of the primary entry.
Primary entry preference order: slug `main` → slug `_legacy` → oldest entry.

Query parameters:
- `locale` (string, optional) — filter localized field values (e.g., "ja", "en")

Response:
```json
{
  "formSet": { "id": "uuid", "slug": "string", "name": "string", "description": "string|null" },
  "entry": { "id": "uuid", "slug": "string" },
  "revision": { "id": "uuid", "revision": 3, "updatedAt": "ISO8601" },
  "data": { "<field_key>": "<value>" },
  "mediaUrls": { "<field_key>": "https://..." }
}
```

---

### GET /form-sets/{formSetSlug}/entries

Returns a paginated list of published entries in a form set.

Query parameters:
- `page` (integer, default 1) — page number, 1-based
- `limit` (integer, default 20, max 100) — items per page
- `offset` (integer) — alternative to `page`; byte offset into result set
- `locale` (string) — filter localized field values
- `q` (string) — full-text search keyword (Business plan+)
- `sort` (string) — sort key, e.g., `created_at:desc`, `updated_at:asc`, `published_date:asc`
- `include_snapshot` (boolean, default false) — include `snapshot` (field values) and `mediaUrls` in each item

Response:
```json
{
  "formSet": { "id": "uuid", "slug": "string", "name": "string", "description": "string|null" },
  "total": 42,
  "limit": 20,
  "offset": 0,
  "items": [
    {
      "entry": { "id": "uuid", "slug": "string" },
      "published": {
        "revisionId": "uuid",
        "revision": 3,
        "updatedAt": "ISO8601",
        "snapshot": { "<field_key>": "<value>" },   // only if include_snapshot=true
        "mediaUrls": { "<field_key>": "https://..." } // only if include_snapshot=true
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

---

### GET /form-sets/{formSetSlug}/entries/{entrySlug}

Returns full published content for a specific entry.

Behavior: if the entry's slug has changed, returns HTTP 301 with `Location` header pointing to the new URL. Clients should follow redirects.

Query parameters:
- `locale` (string, optional) — filter localized field values

Response:
```json
{
  "formSet": { "id": "uuid", "slug": "string", "name": "string" },
  "entry": { "id": "uuid", "slug": "string" },
  "revision": { "id": "uuid", "revision": 3, "updatedAt": "ISO8601" },
  "data": { "<field_key>": "<value>" },
  "mediaUrls": { "<field_key>": "https://..." },
  "widgetRoles": { "<field_key>": "title|thumbnail|description|date|category" }
}
```

---

### GET /content/by-path

Look up content by an import path (set during content migration from external systems).

Query parameters:
- `path` (string, required) — the import path value
- `locale` (string, optional)

Returns same structure as single entry endpoint.

---

### GET /content/by-slug

Look up content using form set slug and entry slug as query parameters.

Query parameters:
- `formSetSlug` (string, required)
- `slug` (string, required)
- `locale` (string, optional)

Returns same structure as single entry endpoint.

---

### GET /content/by-external-id

Look up content by external system entity identifier.

Query parameters:
- `sourceType` (string, required, max 50) — external system name, e.g., "wordpress", "shopify"
- `entityType` (string, required, max 200) — entity type, e.g., "post", "product"
- `externalId` (string, required, max 2000) — the external system's identifier

Returns same structure as single entry endpoint.

---

### GET /preview/revisions

Fetch an unpublished revision using a signed JWT token (generated from the admin panel).

Query parameters:
- `token` (string, required) — JWT signed with the server's secret, valid 15 minutes

Returns 401 after token expiry. Returns same structure as single entry endpoint.
Works for all revision statuses including `draft`.

---

### GET /media/{assetId}

Serve a media file (image, document, etc.) from Cloudflare R2.

Response headers:
- `Content-Type`: MIME type of the file
- `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000` — 1-year CDN + browser cache
- `ETag`: opaque identifier for conditional requests

Accepts `Accept: image/webp` header — returns WebP-optimized image when available.

---

### GET /sitemap.xml

XML sitemap (Sitemap Protocol 0.9) covering all published entries across all form sets.
Includes `<loc>`, `<lastmod>`, `<changefreq>`, and `<priority>`.

---

### GET /form-sets/{slug}/sitemap.xml

XML sitemap for a single form set's published entries only.

---

### GET /form-sets/{formSetSlug}/entries/{entrySlug}/schema.json

schema.org JSON-LD structured data for the entry. Suitable for `<script type="application/ld+json">`.

Response:
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Article",
  "headline": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "image": "https://...",
  "datePublished": "ISO8601",
  "dateModified": "ISO8601",
  "author": { "@type": "Organization", "name": "string" }
}
```

---

### GET /form-sets/{formSetSlug}/entries/{entrySlug}/ogp.json

Open Graph Protocol metadata as a JSON object.

Response:
```json
{
  "og:title": "string",
  "og:description": "string",
  "og:image": "https://...",
  "og:url": "https://...",
  "og:type": "article",
  "og:site_name": "string",
  "twitter:card": "summary_large_image"
}
```

---

### POST /contact-forms/{slug}/submit

Submit a contact form.

Request:
```
Content-Type: application/json
{ "<field_key>": "<value>", ... }
```

Success response (200):
```json
{ "ok": true, "submissionId": "uuid" }
```

Error response (400):
```json
{ "error": { "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "string" } }
```

---

### GET /llms.txt

Short AI-readable API summary (llms.txt spec). Suitable for system prompts.

---

### GET /llms-full.txt

This document — full API specification for AI agents.

## Field Types

All field values appear inside the `data` object.

| Field Type | Value Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | Single-line. Localizable when `localizable: true`. |
| `textarea` | string | Multi-line plain text. Localizable when `localizable: true`. |
| `tiptap` | string (HTML) | Rich text. Localizable when `localizable: true`. |
| `number` | number | Integer or decimal. |
| `boolean` | boolean | `true` or `false`. |
| `date` | string | ISO 8601 date `"2025-01-15"` or datetime `"2025-01-15T09:00:00Z"`. |
| `select` | string | Single selected value. |
| `radio` | string | Single selected value. |
| `multiselect` | string[] | Array of selected values. |
| `image` | string | Asset UUID. Resolve to URL via `mediaUrls[key]`. |
| `file` | string | Asset UUID. Resolve to URL via `mediaUrls[key]`. |
| `video_embed` | string | Embed URL (YouTube, Vimeo, etc.). |
| `entry_ref` | string | Slug of the referenced entry in the linked form set. |

### Localized Field Values

When a field has `localizable: true`, add `?locale=<code>` to requests (e.g., `?locale=ja`).
If the requested locale has no value, the default locale's value is returned.

---

## Pagination

All list endpoints support page-based or offset-based pagination.

```
GET /form-sets/{slug}/entries?page=2&limit=50
```

Response fields:
- `total` — total number of matching published entries
- `limit` — items per page as requested
- `offset` — starting index of this page (0-based)

Algorithm to iterate all pages:
1. Request page 1 with desired limit
2. Process `items`
3. Continue if `offset + limit < total`, incrementing `page`

Python example:
```python
page = 1
limit = 100
all_items = []

while True:
    res = await client.get(url, params={"page": page, "limit": limit, "include_snapshot": "true"})
    data = res.json()
    all_items.extend(data["items"])
    if data["offset"] + limit >= data["total"]:
        break
    page += 1
```

---

## Caching

All public content endpoints support HTTP conditional requests:

- `ETag` response header — opaque identifier for the current content version
- `If-None-Match` request header — send back the ETag to receive `304 Not Modified` if unchanged
- `Cache-Control: public, max-age=60` — CDN and browser caching for 60 seconds
- Media endpoint: `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000` (1 year, immutable)

---

## Error Codes

| Code | HTTP Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Form set or entry does not exist or is not published |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Missing or invalid query parameters |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | 401 | Token missing, expired, or invalid (preview endpoint only) |
| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 | Access denied |
| `PLAN_REQUIRED` | 403 | Full-text search (`?q=`) requires Business plan or above |
| `CONFLICT` | 409 | Conflict (e.g., duplicate slug on write operations) |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Unexpected server error; retry after a delay |

---

## HTTP Status Codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 200 | Success |
| 301 | Entry slug changed — follow `Location` header to new URL |
| 304 | Content unchanged — use cached version (ETag match) |
| 400 | Bad request |
| 401 | Authentication required or invalid (preview only) |
| 403 | Forbidden (plan required or access denied) |
| 404 | Not found |
| 500 | Server error |

---

## Revision Workflow Reference

| Status | Meaning | Visible in Public API |
|---|---|---|
| `draft` | Work in progress | No |
| `pending_review` | Submitted for approval | No |
| `scheduled` | Approved, auto-publishes at `publish_at` | No |
| `published` | Live, returned by Public API | Yes |
| `rejected` | Returned for rework | No |
| `superseded` | Replaced by a newer published revision | No |

---

## Webhook Payloads (for integrations)

luno sends HTTP POST to configured webhook URLs when entries change.

Event types:
- `entry.published` — entry goes live (immediate or scheduled)
- `entry.updated` — published entry's content is replaced
- `entry.deleted` — entry is removed

Payload:
```json
{
  "event": "entry.published",
  "tenant_id": "uuid",
  "form_set_slug": "string",
  "entry_slug": "string",
  "entry_id": "uuid",
  "published_at": "ISO8601",
  "data": { "<field_key>": "<value>" }
}
```

Signature header: `X-Luno-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of raw body>`

Verification (Node.js):
```js
const sig = "sha256=" + crypto.createHmac("sha256", secret).update(rawBody, "utf8").digest("hex");
crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(receivedSig), Buffer.from(sig));
```

---

## Agent API (Admin, requires agent API key)

AI agents can create and publish content using an agent API key (`sk-agent-` prefix).

Base URL: https://{your-domain}/admin/v1
Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer sk-agent_<key>`

Key scopes:
- `full` (recommended) — entries, media, Form Set / Contact / Blueprint
- `content` — entries, revisions, publish, media, read schema
- `schema` — same as `full` (compat alias)

MCP: `npx @luno-cms/mcp setup` then keys in `.agents/luno/{dev,stg,prod}.env` (gitignored).
Or `npx -y @luno-cms/mcp` with `LUNO_API_URL` + `LUNO_AGENT_KEY`.
Docs: https://doc.luno.rest/en/api/ai-agents
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@luno-cms/mcp

Endpoints (content scope):
- `GET  /form-sets` — list form sets
- `GET  /form-sets/{id}/entries` — list entries (all statuses)
- `POST /form-sets/{id}/entries` — create entry
- `GET  /revisions/{id}` — get revision
- `PATCH /revisions/{id}` — update revision fields
- `POST /revisions/{id}/publish` — publish a revision

Schema scope additionally:
- `POST /form-blueprints/apply`
- `POST /form-set-templates/{id}/apply`
- `POST /contact-forms`

---

## Deployment Architecture

- **API**: Cloudflare Workers (Hono framework)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL via Cloudflare Hyperdrive
- **Media**: Cloudflare R2 (S3-compatible object storage)
- **Admin panel**: Vite 6 + React + Mantine v8 (Cloudflare Pages)
- **Image variants**: Cloudflare Workers Queue (async processing)
- **Scheduled publishing**: Cloudflare Workers Cron Triggers (every minute)
